prospective_final_contract.claim: Replicated local positive-control learning, not architecture promotion, economics, transfer, independent-corpus generalization or a blind holdout.
prospective_final_contract.initialization: Fresh independent initialization per runner seed. Select the recipe/source, never resume dev best.pt.
prospective_final_contract.selection: Same best-trained-dev-checkpoint rule and every-250-update schedule; no shortening or tuning in response to the v2 dev curve.
prospective_final_contract.controls: All original ten controls plus mandatory ordered identified before-fit/after-timing GPU metadata for every v3 replica. Retain metadata during series validation.
prospective_final_contract.baselines: Fresh train-only unigram/bigram and source-identical frozen control in each v3 final run. Never pool v2 scores as final replicas.
prospective_final_contract.uncertainty: All three seed values, mean, sample SD, range and paired t interval df=2, conditional on the one corpus; no independence claim for byte targets.
prospective_final_contract.failure_policy: Every failed, timed-out, invalid or omitted replica prevents a positive series verdict. No replacement seed or holdout-guided rescue; a valid final negative closes this tested version.
prospective_final_contract.transition: Bind the exact selected v2 plan/result/source/evaluator and current separately certified v3 evaluator in the actual immutable series. The contract alone never permits execution.
prospective_final_contract.remaining_boundary: STOP/PAUSE, maintenance, integrity, pending-plan, audit-before-seed and cumulative attempt/fit guards remain mandatory. One final experiment per bounded cycle.
